noProject.title: No project is open
noProject.description: Create or open a project to run methods on its decision problem.

noDataset.title: This project has no decision problem yet
noDataset.description: Add alternatives, criteria and values in the Decision Matrix first.

problems.title: The data cannot be used yet
problems.no-matrix: The decision problem has no decision matrix.
problems.too-small: At least two alternatives and two criteria are needed.

cell.fuzzy-in-classical: {alternative} has a fuzzy value for {criterion}, but the classical model needs plain numbers. Choose the fuzzy (TFN) model or replace the value.
cell.no-scale: {alternative} has a linguistic term for {criterion}, but the criterion has no linguistic scale.
cell.unknown-term: {alternative} uses “{term}” for {criterion}, which is not a term of the criterion’s scale.

problems.fix: Fix it in the Decision Matrix
problems.validation: The method cannot run with this input

result.utilityChart: Utility functions f(K⁻), f(K⁺) and final utility of each alternative
result.contributionHint: Each cell is the weighted normalized value of an alternative on a criterion. For fuzzy values the most likely value m is shown.
result.heatmapChart: Heat map of the weighted normalized values
result.stepsHint: Every intermediate table of the calculation, exactly as the engine recorded it.

methodHint.critic: Objective weights from contrast and conflict between criteria.
methodHint.merec: Objective weights from the effect of removing each criterion.
methodHint.swara: Subjective weights from comparative importance of ranked criteria.
methodHint.fuzzySwara: SWARA with linguistic comparisons turned into triangular fuzzy numbers.

weighting.matrixInput: Uses the decision matrix of {alternatives} alternatives and {criteria} criteria.

swara.hint: Order the criteria from most to least important, then give the comparative importance s_j of each criterion compared with the one above it.
swara.incomplete: Enter the comparative importance of every criterion except the first.

fuzzySwara.hint: Order the criteria from most to least significant, then pick how much less significant each one is than the one above it.
fuzzySwara.incomplete: Choose a comparison for every criterion except the first.

overview.title: Overview
overview.text: Decision problem “{name}” with {alternatives} alternatives and {criteria} criteria.

criteria.title: Criteria configuration
criteria.hint: Benefit criteria are better when larger, cost criteria when smaller. Change them in the Decision Matrix.
criteria.name: Name

weights.title: Weighting configuration
weights.incomplete: Enter a weight for every criterion.
weights.noneAvailable: There is no weighting analysis for this decision problem yet.
weights.stale: The data changed after this weighting analysis was run.

tfn.title: Fuzzy MARCOS (TFN)
tfn.hint: Triangular fuzzy numbers; plain numbers and linguistic terms are converted.

empty.title: No analyses yet
empty.description: Run a weighting method or MARCOS. Every run is stored in the project and shows up here.
